title: 第三百零五章 扬眉吐气第三百零四章 突厥使团被抓
lines: 观风殿的执事太监从公公年纪不大，是个谨小慎微的人，平日里做事最是小心，一般绝对不轻易开罪人，是出了名的老好人。
今天他奉命打探消息，听到了突厥使团的消息之后他也没有多想，冲进观风殿便禀报了武则天，这一下大殿炸开了锅，所有人都把目光投到了他的身上，他何曾见过这等场面，一时不由得颇为慌张，额头上的汗涔涔而下。
武则天最是热切，她站起身来勃然道：“你说什么？突厥使团被岳四郎给抓了？这是怎么回事？你不要怕，这是好事儿，大好事儿，你原原本本把这事儿说一遍！”
从公公一听武则天这么说，心中立马吃了定心丸，他是看明白了，敢情不是自己说错了话了，而是自己带来的消息让现场所有人都觉得震撼，因而他们都分外关注呢！
这么一想，他的表现欲立刻上来了，再说今天关于突厥使团的事情也着实带劲，让人觉得扬眉吐气，不仅是他从公公瞧着心中舒坦，洛阳的百姓们正奔走相告，人人觉得舒心呢！
于是从公公便把今天突厥使团如何和白马寺生争执，而后洛阳衙役如何介入，岳峰怎么出场，随即岳峰挑战默啜，两人龙争虎斗，最后岳峰战而胜之，让整个突厥使团投鼠忌器，在这种情况下，岳峰果断的抓了使团中二十几个精壮悍勇的牙卫，将他们统统下了大牢，突厥使团狼狈不堪的被鸿胪寺请到了住处，此时他们急得如热窝的蚂蚁。
使团的正使纳尔丹拽着鸿胪寺卿一个劲儿的求情，就是希望能面见武则天，从而求得武则天赦免使团护卫的冒犯之罪。
武则天和众大臣听完了从公公这番话，一个个都觉得心情愉快，武则天尤其没能忍住，哈哈大笑起来，道：“好哇，不错！你们都是老臣谋国，懂得这件小事儿不宜大张旗鼓，我们让洛阳令去办便好！
而洛阳令岳四郎也没让朕失望，他是朕钦点的洛阳令，关键时候敢于行事，办差也很果决果敢，朕很高兴啊！”
武则天笑逐颜开，上官婉儿心中也不由得松了一口气，心中想岳峰还不是银样镴枪头，其蹴鞠是高手，手底下还真有厉害的功夫，突厥的默啜是个悍勇之人，竟然败在了他的手上，这件事如果不是真的发生了，还真让人不敢相信呢！
大臣们也都很高兴，一个个红光满脸，当然，李昭德最是尴尬，但是他却聪明的站在了其他宰相的身后，不当那出头鸟了！
武则天却没有放过他，盯着李昭德道：“李爱卿，汝可不能用老眼光看年轻人，所谓长江后浪推前浪，年轻人是我们武周的将来啊。朕以为岳四郎乃我武周的栋梁之才，以后李卿也不忘要多提携他啊！”
李昭德那个尴尬啊，以他的性子本应该立刻回绝，可是此时此刻，他能说什么？武则天故意要让他难堪呢，他只能低头，唯唯诺诺，心中真是长毛呢！
武则天意犹未尽，当即道：“来人啊，传朕的旨意，着洛阳令岳四郎入宫觐见！”
武则天这个命令传下去，一会儿功夫，传旨的太监就出宫找到了岳峰，此时的岳峰在干什么呢？他被薛怀义宴请着呢！
薛怀义在酒楼的上房里面，点了慢慢一桌子菜，好酒好菜上来了，他也不顾什么礼节，和岳峰对面而坐，道：
“哈哈，薛某这辈子经历了不止多少风雨啊，妈的，要说窝囊，今天真是最窝囊，最窝火！可要说快活，那今天也是最快活！
那帮突厥蛮子着实厉害，老子辛辛苦苦练了那么久的兵根本不是他们的对手，这帮杂毛啊，真是让人痛恨得很呢！今天也是你这个洛阳令厉害，替我出了一口恶气，他妈的，以后咱什么也不用说了，我薛怀义认你这个兄弟了！”
薛怀义张口便来，然后便是往自己肚子里灌酒，岳峰自然客气，道：“薛师的威风不仅洛阳知道，天下人都知道！那默啜来自蛮夷，没有见过什么世面。像这种货色在洛阳闹事，倘若薛师您出马，那太给这帮犊子脸了！
岳某是洛阳令，这是岳某的本职工作，幸没有辱使命，得薛师夸赞，岳某心中感佩得很啊！”
岳峰这么一说，薛怀义更是大为开怀，岳峰年轻不错，而且懂进退，知道礼仪。这让薛怀义很舒心，要知道薛怀义表面上粗狂，其实心思敏锐得很，他内心其实很在意别人对他的看法，这也是为什么他如此下决心非得要当大将军，非得要亲自领兵打突厥立战功的原因。
他骨子里面不希望别人把他当成是靠武则天上位的小白脸，他无时无刻都想证明自己，奈何，他不通文墨，于读书治学这一条路上根本走不通。所以他一门心思就钻研打仗，想着能在战场上立功劳呢！
薛怀义成了大将军之后，暗中拔擢了不少的人才，在他眼中看来，像岳峰这样厉害的高手，能文能武，而且又行事这般得体的人，那最是难得，因此对岳峰他生了招揽之心了。
薛怀义有此心，岳峰却冷静得很，因为岳峰知道，在历史上武则天宠信二张之后，薛怀义的好日子差不多就要到头了。
薛怀义本身是个性情中人，当他得知二张存在之后，他的情绪完全崩溃了，行了很多不管不顾，情绪化的事情，甚至他一把火把武则天视为皇权象征的明堂给烧了。
最后武则天下了毒手，将薛怀义直接杀死，这样一个传奇人物死得非常悲惨，因此对这么一个人，岳峰心中是怀有警惕之心的！
而恰恰是岳峰的这种心思，让薛怀义对他刮目相看，要知道放眼当今的朝廷，别说是普通的大臣了，就连武氏子弟对薛怀义那都是恭恭敬敬，客客气气，极尽巴结的！
岳峰的态度很诚恳，不卑不亢，这让见惯了那些奴才嘴脸的薛怀义觉得十分的亲切，心中对岳峰更加是看重了呢！
content_en:
The deacon and eunuch of Guanfeng Palace is not very old. He is a cautious person. He is most cautious in doing things on weekdays. He usually never offends others easily. He is known as a good person.
Today he was ordered to inquire about the news. After hearing the news about the Turkic mission, he didn't think much about it. He rushed into the Guanfeng Hall and reported it to Wu Zetian. At this moment, the hall exploded and everyone turned their attention to him. He had never seen such a scene before. He couldn't help but panic for a moment, and sweat dripped down his forehead.
Wu Zetian was the most enthusiastic. She stood up and said angrily: "What did you say? The Turkic envoy was arrested by Yue Silang? What happened? Don't be afraid. This is a good thing, a great thing. Tell me exactly what happened!"
When the father-in-law heard what Wu Zetian said, he immediately felt reassured. He understood clearly that it was not that he had said the wrong thing, but that the news he had brought shocked everyone present, so they all paid special attention to it!
Thinking of this, his desire for expression immediately came up. Besides, what happened today about the Turkic mission was really exciting and made people feel proud. Not only did he feel comfortable when his father-in-law looked at it, but the people of Luoyang were running around to tell each other. Everyone felt comfortable!
So my father-in-law told how the Turkic mission had a dispute with the White Horse Temple today, how the Luoyang government officials intervened, and how Yue Feng appeared. Then Yue Feng challenged Mochu, and the two fought fiercely. In the end, Yue Feng won the battle and made the entire Turkic mission surrender. In this situation, Yue Feng decisively captured more than 20 strong and brave tooth guards in the mission and put them all in prison. The Turkic mission was invited to their residence by Honglu Temple in a state of embarrassment. At this time, they were as anxious as ants in a hot nest.
Nardan, the envoy of the mission, dragged the Minister of Honglu Temple to plead for mercy, hoping to meet Wu Zetian in order to ask Wu Zetian to forgive the offense committed by the mission's guards.
After hearing what Eunuch Cong said, Wu Zetian and all the ministers felt happy. Wu Zetian especially couldn't hold it back and laughed loudly and said: "Okay, that's right! You are all veteran ministers seeking the country. You know that this small matter should not be made public. We can just let the Luoyang Order handle it!"
And Yue Silang, the Ling of Luoyang, did not disappoint me. He is the Ling of Luoyang whom I personally appointed. He dares to act at critical moments and is decisive and courageous in handling errands. I am very happy! "
Wu Zetian smiled broadly, and Shangguan Wan'er couldn't help but breathed a sigh of relief. She thought to herself that Yue Feng was not a silver pewter spear head, but that he was a master at Cuju and had really powerful skills. Tujue Mo Chuo was a brave man, but he was defeated by him. If this didn't really happen, it would be unbelievable!
The ministers were also very happy, and their faces were all red. Of course, Li Zhaode was the most embarrassed, but he wisely stood behind the other prime ministers and stopped being the one who stood out!
Wu Zetian did not let him go, staring at Li Zhaode and saying: "Li Aiqing, you can't look at young people with old eyes. As the saying goes, the waves behind the Yangtze River push the waves ahead. Young people are the future of our Wu Zhou. I think Yue Silang is the pillar of our Wu Zhou, and Li Qing will not forget to support him in the future!"
Li Zhaode was so embarrassed. With his temperament, he should have refused immediately, but at this moment, what could he say? Wu Zetian deliberately wanted to embarrass him, but he could only lower his head and obey, feeling really hairy in his heart!
Wu Zetian's intention was still unfinished, and he immediately said: "Come here, tell me my decree, and send Yue Silang to Luoyang to come to the palace to see you!"
Wu Zetian's order was passed down. After a while, the eunuch who delivered the order came out of the palace and found Yue Feng. What was Yue Feng doing at this time? He was being entertained by Xue Huaiyi!
Xue Huaiyi was in the upper room of the restaurant, slowly ordering a table of dishes. Good wine and good food were served. He didn't care about etiquette, sat across from Yue Feng, and said:
"Haha, Xue has gone through a lot of ups and downs in his life. Damn it, today is the most cowardly and the most angry! But when it comes to happiness, today is also the happiest!
Those Turkic barbarians are really powerful. The soldiers I have worked so hard to train for so long are no match for them. These bastards are really detestable! Today, you, the powerful Luoyang Commander, vented your anger on my behalf. Damn it, we don’t have to say anything from now on. I, Xue Huaiyi, recognize you as my brother! "
Xue Huaiyi opened his mouth and poured wine into his stomach. Yue Feng was naturally polite and said: "Master Xue's majesty is known not only to Luoyang, but also to everyone in the world! That Mochui comes from a barbarian and has never seen much of the world. If a guy like this is causing trouble in Luoyang, if Master Xue takes action, it will be too shameful for these brats!"
Yue is the order of Luoyang. This is Yue's own job. Fortunately, he has fulfilled his mission and was praised by Master Xue. Yue is very grateful! "
When Yue Feng said this, Xue Huaiyi was even more happy. Yue Feng was young and good, and he knew how to advance and retreat, and knew etiquette. This made Xue Huaiyi very comfortable. You must know that Xue Huaiyi looked rough and arrogant on the surface, but he was actually very sharp. In his heart, he actually cared about what others thought of him. This was why he was so determined to become a general and to personally lead troops to defeat the Turks and achieve military exploits.
Deep down, he didn't want others to regard him as a pretty boy who relied on Wu Zetian to rise to power. He wanted to prove himself all the time. However, he didn't know how to read and write, and he couldn't get on the path of studying and studying. So he concentrated on studying war, thinking that he could make contributions on the battlefield!
After Xue Huaiyi became the general, he secretly promoted many talents. In his eyes, a powerful master like Yue Feng, who was capable of literary and military skills and behaved in such a decent manner, was the most rare. Therefore, he wanted to recruit Yue Feng.
Xue Huaiyi had this intention, but Yue Feng was very calm, because Yue Feng knew that after Wu Zetian favored Er Zhang in history, Xue Huaiyi's good days were almost over.
Xue Huaiyi himself was a temperamental person. When he learned about the existence of Er Zhang, his mood completely collapsed and he did many reckless and emotional things. He even burned down the Mingtang, which Wu Zetian regarded as a symbol of imperial power.
In the end, Wu Zetian killed Xue Huaiyi directly. Such a legendary figure died very tragically, so Yue Feng was wary of such a person!
It was precisely Yue Feng's thoughts that made Xue Huaiyi look at him with new eyes. You must know that looking at today's imperial court, let alone ordinary ministers, even the children of the Wu family are respectful, polite and extremely flattering to Xue Huaiyi!
Yue Feng's attitude was very sincere, neither humble nor arrogant. This made Xue Huaiyi, who was used to seeing those servants, feel very kind, and he valued Yue Feng even more!
title_en: Chapter 305: Feeling proud Chapter 304: The Turkic envoy was captured
